dropzone.title: Drag a photo here
dropzone.hint: JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF. Large photos are shrunk automatically.

gallery.count: {count, plural, =0 {No photos yet} other {# of {max} photos}}

placeholder.hint: An AI illustration, not the real place. Replace it with a real photo.

url.label: Image URL
url.invalid: Only URLs from images.unsplash.com are accepted.

errors.tooLarge: The photo is too large (max. 8 MB). Make it smaller first, for example by sending it to yourself on WhatsApp and saving it, then upload it again.
errors.unsupported: Unsupported format. Use JPEG, PNG, WebP or AVIF.
errors.tooManyPixels: The photo resolution is too large (max. 40 megapixels). Make it smaller first, for example by sending it to yourself on WhatsApp and saving it, then upload it again.
errors.corrupt: The image file is damaged or unreadable.
errors.rateLimited: Too many photos uploaded in a short time. Wait a few minutes, then try again.

warnings.notLandscape: This photo is not landscape, so its top and bottom will be cropped on the page. A landscape photo works best.
warnings.small: This photo is small ({width} pixels wide), so it may look blurry on the page. Use the original from the camera, at least 1600 pixels wide.

form.sectionHint: Upload your own photos or use URLs from images.unsplash.com. Photos are converted to WebP and location metadata is removed.
form.galleryHint: Up to 12 photos. The cover photo is always shown largest on the tour page, followed by the gallery photos in this order. Click the star on a photo to make it the cover.
form.waitForUploads: Wait for the photos to finish uploading before saving.
form.creditsHint: Once saved, photos you upload can be credited (photographer's name) on the <link>Photo credits</link> page. Your own photos need no credit.
